nodes.name: Schedule Trigger - Daily 07:00 UTC
nodes.notes: Daily digest schedule. Workflow timezone is explicitly UTC.

nodes.name: HTTP - Get Daily Stats
nodes.notes: Read-only aggregate stats call. The URL and shared token come from n8n environment variables. Endpoint errors are passed to validation and never become an email digest.

nodes.name: Validate Stats Response
nodes.notes: Only validated aggregate fields continue to formatting. Invalid responses are skipped without exposing response details.

nodes.name: Switch - Stats Available?
nodes.notes: Only a validated response reaches email formatting. Endpoint failures follow the fallback output and produce no email.

nodes.name: Format Daily Digest
nodes.notes: Deterministic text and HTML rendering. The digest contains counts and safe identifiers only; tuning suggestions require human approval.

nodes.name: Email - Daily Digest
nodes.notes: Daily digest email through the existing SMTP Lab Mailpit credential. Recipients and sender come from n8n environment variables.

parameters.functionCode:
// Safe terminal branch: do not email an incomplete report.
return { json: { status: 'skipped', reason: 'stats_endpoint_failed' } };

nodes.name: Fail Safe - Skip Digest
nodes.notes: Stats failure is non-destructive and produces no email. Operators can inspect the n8n execution status without a partial digest.

meta.description: Phase 3.9 daily SOC digest: 07:00 UTC schedule, read-only stats API, deterministic safe formatting, existing SMTP Lab Mailpit credential, no automatic Wazuh rule changes, and no autonomous actions.
